title: Record a swing
puttFaceOn: Putts work best filmed from the front (face-on): from behind the putter moves towards the camera and the stroke cannot be timed.

viewHint.down_the_line: Behind you, looking at the target

guideTitle: How to set up the phone

common.upright: Phone upright on a tripod or leaning on your bag – not in your hand.
common.whole: Your whole body must be in the picture – and the club above your head at the top.

guide.face_on: Stand facing the phone, the phone opposite your chest.
guide.down_the_line: Phone behind your hands, on a line parallel to where you aim (the target line). You stand on the {left} of the picture.

uploadSub: From your photos – also slow motion
noCamera: The camera only works over a secure connection (https) or is blocked. You can still upload a video.

issue.multiple_people: Several people in the picture – only you, please
issue.body_cut_off: Head or feet not in the picture – step back or point the phone lower
issue.too_far: You are too small – come closer
issue.no_headroom: Leave room above your head for the club
issue.camera_tilted: Phone tilted – hold it upright and level

stage.scan: Looking for the swing in the video
stage.pose: Finding your body in every frame

slowmo.title: Slow-motion video?
slowmo.text: This swing looks about {f}× slower than a real swing. Was it filmed in slow motion?

error.load_failed: This video could not be opened. Try another one (MP4 or MOV).
error.no_frames: No pictures could be read from this video.
error.camera: The camera could not be started. Allow camera access in the settings or upload a video.
error.noRecorder: This browser cannot record video. Please upload a video instead.
